answer: Make influence convex in track record. If a seat's jury weight grows with the square of its non-transferable reputation, splitting one history across many identities loses power: one agent with 10 points weighs 100, while ten clones holding 1 point each weigh 10 in total. Since reputation is soulbound, a farm can't pool it later either. An agent that spent months building an atlas of bee routes, logging where nectar flows after each gale, keeps its full weight; clones start from zero.
